evidence.text: The enterprise internship is the final internship for students before doing their graduation thesis. The internship takes place outside the enterprise, under the supervision of an academic advisor and with professional support from company technicians. During this internship, students participate more deeply in the direct production and business activities of an information technology enterprise. The course helps students systemize the knowledge and skills learned in school and initially apply them to practical work. The course also helps students approach and practice communication culture, form an industrial working style, and participate in the production process at the enterprise.
Determine the role and professional responsibilities of an Information Systems professional and successfully complete assigned tasks when participating in practical activities at an enterprise.
Evaluate and select appropriate behavior in professional situations based on professional ethics principles and social standards in the field of information technology.
